label: Negation of the exact countertuple actual moved not potent…, by Rival excluded by deeper…
meaning: Conditional refutation of the exact countertuple STMT-ACTUAL-MOVED-NOT-POTENT-COUNTERTUPLE. What is being moved toward r is able to be r (Metaphysics IX.3, STMT-WHAT-IS-BEING-MOVED-TO-R-IS-ABLE-TO-BE-R) and is not yet actually r (Physics III.2, STMT-WHAT-IS-BEING-MOVED-TO-R-IS-NOT-YET-R); by the right-to-left direction of Metaphysics IX.6's analysis (STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY) it is then in potency to r. The countertuple must reject one of these three Aristotelian analyses; this route does not use the Physics III.1 analysis. Each premise is needed (STMT-RIVAL-REFUTATIONS-ROUND2-CONTROLS). Sense-relative: InAct, InPotency and CanBe must be read in one sense across the three premises (DISAMB-IN-ACT, DISAMB-POTENCY). The premises are open, so the refutation does not count for closure.
